mxCell.value:
User Input
either by clicking on buttons or by writing

converts to LaTeX

for user readability

tokenization

xy becomes x*y, cos stays cos. functions get recognized

bracket-handling

Open brackets get closed, different groups get recognized

trigonometric equations

trig equations are linked to their own (non-hardcoded) solutions which are more human-readable than the nerdamer output

factor

nerdamer fails with "factor" and exponents, this is something we fixed with an intercept using "expand"

depth-first search

a depth first search is done by looking through the ordering of the brackets. This essentially creates an abstract syntax tree to search through.

nerdamer calculation

We call nerdamer calculations to be done every time we see a node of the the AST. This allows us to do every step carefully and to record the steps.

string to LaTeX

One of the nerdamer (text) output is then parsed and converted to LaTeX. This is done with using "\", "{}" and using specific names like "frac" where needed, around the respective parts.
<font style="font-size: 11px;">To copy paste into AI discussions readily</font>

Postprocessing

The text form output is duplicated so that it can be put into the text output. The number of significant figures in the answer is counted. If more than 7 then a slider that lets truncate the s.f. appears.
